name: clawd-band
description: A band above the prompt: an animated Clawd sprite, five-hour and weekly usage bars with a countdown to each window's reset, and a context-window bar with a countdown until the prompt cache goes cold

show_model.title: Show model and effort
show_model.description: Show the model and reasoning effort (e.g. Opus 5.5 high) on the line under Clawd. Off makes the band three rows tall.

sprite_color.title: Clawd colour
sprite_color.description: Clawd's body colour, as hex (#d77757 is Claude orange).

bar_color_low.title: Bar colour below 60%
bar_color_low.description: A theme key (success, claude, suggestion, ...), a colour name (green) or hex (#4eba65).

bar_color_mid.title: Bar colour from 60%
bar_color_mid.description: A theme key, a colour name or hex.

bar_color_high.title: Bar colour from 85%
bar_color_high.description: A theme key, a colour name or hex.

bar_color_empty.title: Empty bar colour
bar_color_empty.description: The unfilled part of each bar: a theme key, a colour name or hex.

bar_color_cold.title: Context bar colour when the cache is cold
bar_color_cold.description: The context bar and its countdown once the prompt cache has lapsed: a theme key, a colour name or hex.

cache_ttl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cache_ttl.description: How long the API keeps the prompt cache after a reply: 1h (subscriptions) or 5m (API keys, usage overage).
